name: coke-oven-pah-heat-stress-planner

OSHA Art 125 (작업환경측정 — uncited) + OSHA Art 130 (특수건강진단 — uncited) + DSSMA Art 5 (코크스 — uncited) + OSHA Art 38 + SAPA Art 4.
